text: [Building Software by Rolling the Dice](/research/2026-fse/) was selected for an ACM SIGSOFT Distinguished Paper Award at FSE 2026. It is one of 10 distinguished papers among 211 accepted research papers.

Our follow-up to Learning from Mistakes, [Following Breadcrumbs in Code](/research/2026-emse/), has been accepted to Empirical Software Engineering (EMSE)! It extends our study of ad-hoc logs to Java, JavaScript, and Python.
Happy to share that our paper [FSE 2026](/research/2026-fse/) Building Software by Rolling the Dice: A Qualitative Study of Vibe Coding have been accepted! See you all in Canada (AGAIN)!
I’m thrilled to share that I have been awarded the Taiwan Government Scholarship to Study Abroad ($32,000)!

Excited to announce that our paper [MSR 2025](/research/2025-msr/) Learning from Mistakes: Understanding Ad-hoc Logs through Analyzing Accidental Commits has been accepted! See you all in Ottawa, Canada!

Delighted to share that our paper [Organize, Then Vote: Exploring Cognitive Load in Quadratic Survey Interfaces](https://doi.org/10.1145/3706598.3714193) (CHI 2025) has been accepted! Huge thanks to [Ti-Chung Cheng](https://tichung.com/about/) for driving this work forward!
I will join the PEACH Lab at ETH Zürich for a research exchange from September to November 2024, working with [Prof. April Wang](https://aprilwang.me/)!

Interested in undergraduate research? Please see the [research opportunity page](/opportunities/) for current projects and relevant skills. Students from any major are welcome to get in touch. Email me with a short introduction, your interests, and what motivates you to work together. Looking forward to your emails!
I am excited to share that I will join UIST as student volunteer this year. see you all at San Francisco!
I am excited to share that I will be interning with the SAP, Newport Beach this summer with Prof. Tobias Schimmer!
Congrats! Zhendong is officially Dr. Zhendong Wang!
